title: Autonomous multi-agent ML engineering loop
summary: A team of autonomous Claude Code agents running endless headless sessions across several machines and coordinating only through git. Planner, builder, reviewer, explorer and janitor roles; git task locks; a gated landing flow with a sealed holdout and a bit-exact replica of the validator's scorer; content-addressed cached evaluation; and a supervisor dashboard for machines, jobs and the live scoreboard.

title: Large-scale model distillation
summary: Competitive model distillation on a Bittensor subnet: compressing a 1T-parameter MoE teacher into students of at most 33B, scored on a 25+ axis composite covering math, code, reasoning, long context and honesty.

title: Video upscaling and compression subnet
summary: Vidaio (SN85): decentralized AI video upscaling and compression, with miners and validators scored on perceptual quality.

title: Live-web agent benchmark
summary: Real-time evaluation framework for LLM browser agents on live websites (CoinGecko, Taostats, Stooq, weather), plus SFT dataset generation aligned with the benchmark.

title: Issue-to-pull-request coding agent
summary: Reads a problem description from an issue or a /patch comment, finds the relevant files, generates edits with an LLM, commits a valid patch on a new branch and opens a pull request with tests and linters run in CI.

title: Bittensor monitoring bot
summary: Telegram bot for real-time Bittensor monitoring: subnet parameter changes, registrations and costs, unstaking, stake thresholds and wallet activity, plus miner and validator registration from chat.

title: Video compression toolkit
summary: Encoder wrapper, VMAF quality scoring, scene classification and a learned image-quality model for compressing video without visible loss.

title: Roadwork image classifier
summary: Classifier training for the Natix network: multi-backbone runs (ConvNeXt, EfficientNet, ViT, Swin) over real and synthetic roadwork images.

title: Biometrics and captioning demos
summary: Documentation and demos for face and fingerprint recognition, image captioning and encrypted face recognition.

title: MoE fine-tuning toolkit
summary: Fine-tuning toolkit for DeepSeek-V3-architecture MoE models (Moonlight-16B-A3B): LoRA/QLoRA, full SFT, DPO with DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, and forward-KL distillation from a local or logprob-cached teacher, served with SGLang.

title: LLM-judge data pipeline
summary: End-to-end data pipeline: vLLM generation of king and challenger replies, LLM-judge scoring, and SFT/DPO/GRPO/RFT dataset building on a MySQL-backed store with read-only-by-default tooling.

title: Offline reward replica & RL training
summary: Offline replica of a subnet's three-judge evaluation reward, used to answer "would this model win?" before spending an on-chain upload, with SFT, DPO, self-play and online/offline GRPO trainers.

title: Token-efficient reasoning trainer
summary: GRPO LoRA training whose reward calls the validator's own scoring function, rewarding correct answers that use fewer tokens than the base model across math, multiple-choice and long-context evidence-selection benchmarks.

title: 72B inference optimization
summary: Optimized Qwen2.5-72B serving image for a Bittensor inference subnet on 4×H200, tuned for time-to-first-token and throughput under a strict logprob-correctness gate, with a local copy of the validator for scoring.

title: LLM fine-tune & OpenAI-compatible serving
summary: Fetches and cleans agent conversation data into ShareGPT format, fine-tunes with LLaMA-Factory, and serves the result behind an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API.

title: Distributed MoE training subnet
summary: Contributions to Subnet 102, which trains Mixture-of-Experts LLMs collaboratively, with expert groups spread across independent miners.

title: Agent evaluation framework
summary: Evaluation and training framework for AgentGym-style benchmarks: logic-reasoning dataset generation, QLoRA/SFT/MoE-routing training, prompt policies for game environments, and SWE, live-web and game environments.

title: RL-trained SWE agent
summary: Extension of mini-swe-agent, the 100-line software-engineering agent, for reinforcement learning from human and dataset trajectories.

title: AgentGym agent collection
summary: LLM-driven and hand-written agents for AgentGym environments such as SciWorld and TextCraft, on OpenAI-compatible APIs.

title: Crypto analysis agent API
summary: LLM agent that classifies crypto questions into six categories (portfolio, yield farming, trading and more) and routes each one to specialized tools.

title: Multi-task RL robot agent
summary: Agent template for the Kinitro embodied-AI subnet: offline TD3+BC and online RL on the MetaWorld MT50 robot-manipulation tasks.

title: Embodied-agent gym
summary: Eastworld (SN94): gyms for evaluating and training embodied, generally capable AI agents in an open virtual world.

title: Time-series generator tooling
summary: Measurement and cost-aware A/B sweep suite for time-series generator development on a Bittensor subnet, built on the subnet's real evaluation pool, plus the resulting model variants.

title: ML data & deployment utilities
summary: Small services around the training loop: a Hugging Face dataset watcher that pulls, unpacks and triggers training on new revisions; a FastAPI patch server for SWE-bench Pro; an upload/download bucket server; and deployment scripts for serving large models on Chutes.

title: Market-signal embedding miner
summary: Miner for MANTIS (SN123): embeddings that help predict one-hour moves of financial instruments.

title: Identity-testing subnet backend
summary: Backend for MIID (SN54), the identity-testing subnet.

title: AI vulnerability detection subnet
summary: Contributions to BitSec, which uses AI to find and fix vulnerabilities in subnet codebases and smart contracts.

title: CheckerChain scoring endpoint
summary: Scoring endpoint service for the CheckerChain subnet.

title: Affine mining dashboard
summary: Dashboard for Affine (SN120) mining: sortable and filterable miner tables, auto-refresh and personal hotkey tracking.

title: Fast on-chain registration CLI
summary: Rust CLI for Bittensor subnet registration that fans out across several RPC endpoints, submits on new block heads and raises the tip over replace-by-fee rounds.

title: Sui trading bot
summary: TypeScript sniper and trading bot for meme coins on the Sui blockchain.

title: Token presale dApp
summary: Token presale dApp: React + Vite + Tailwind frontend with its smart contract.

title: DeFi TVL adapter
summary: DeFiLlama adapter that reports total value locked for the HyperLoan protocol.

title: Bitcoin NFT browser wallet
summary: Contributions to an open-source browser-extension wallet for Bitcoin NFTs.
